title: Multi-head attention
hints: Project once with the full (d_model, d_model) matrices, then split: x.reshape(B, T, H, d_head) followed by transpose(0, 2, 1, 3) gives (B, H, T, d_head). Reshaping straight to (B, H, T, d_head) scrambles tokens across heads.
The provided attention() broadcasts over the leading (B, H) dims, so one call handles every head, and the scale inside it uses d_head, not d_model.
Merge with the inverse moves, transpose(0, 2, 1, 3) then reshape(B, T, d_model), and finish with @ Wo.
